Title: Verify that order creation with malicious base64 image data containing path traversal sequences is rejected to prevent injection
Section: Order Management - Photo Upload and Retrieval
Preconditions: User is authenticated and has permissions to create orders. A valid order payload is prepared with all required fields except the photo field.
Steps:
1. Prepare a base64-encoded image payload that includes path traversal sequences (e.g., '../../malicious.jpg'). 2. Submit the order creation request with this malicious base64 data in the 'customerPhoto' or 'measurementClothPhoto' field. 3. Observe the API response.

Test Data: Base64 string: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,../../malicious.jpg'
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and an error message indicating invalid image data. No order is created, and no photo is stored.
